note: Provincial-park campgrounds on Blackstrap Lake, a reservoir southeast of Saskatoon. Kevin Misfeldt (electric and non-electric) and Sunset Ridge (electric and full service, set back on the hill) sit together on the southeast shore; Hazelnut Grove, 19 electric sites on a wooded point about 4.5 km northeast, is the winter-camping loop. 7 Sunset Ridge sites are seasonal. --Claude
